hypothesis: Shared engine preserves exact historical interventions, tests fixed training-selected S2 predictor with high-grade and same-grade donors, and verifies coordinate-only bag invariance.
output_kind: real-input engineering acceptance and placement ablation; not independent scientific validation
independent_unit: unique host slide; donors and seeds reused, patient independence unknown
predictor_selection_uses: training-only nested CV, frozen before contamination; known calibration is descriptive only
placement_subdose_policy: Keep the maximal-fragment rigid translation fixed; exclude each nested prefix unless its actual footprints remain valid and near observed tissue. Never relax the distance or search using predictions.

resume_prior_run.failure_category: placement eligibility of nested subdose was not handled; no oracle failure
